summary: Full frontend regression of 'Jampo's Crisis Shield AI' v4 (client-only React). All 15 requested feature areas verified via Playwright against public preview URL. No blockers found; every module works end-to-end.

test_results.rebranding: PASS — brand-title='Jampo\'s Crisis Shield AI', subtitle contains 'v4.0', browser tab title matches, footer shows JAMPO'S CRISIS SHIELD AI © 2026.
test_results.7_continents: PASS — all 7 continent buttons present (na, sa, eu, asia, africa, oceania, antarctica). Oceania loads Sydney/Queensland/NZ venues; Antarctica loads McMurdo/Peninsula venues; venue-warning updates per hazard.
test_results.us_state_layer: PASS — us-state-select shows 55 options (blank + 50 states + DC + Puerto Rico + Guam + USVI). Selecting 'California' (id='ca') auto-switches hazard to Wildfire Threat, shows 'ACTIVE CONFIG · CALIFORNIA' badge, venue-warning label 'US STATE CONFIG · CALIFORNIA' with Santa Ana wind-driven mega-fires note, and coords 34.0522°N,118.2437°W. Switching continent (na→sa→na) correctly resets us-state-select to empty.
test_results.uk_kingdom_layer: PASS — Europe shows 4 UK kingdom chips (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland). Scotland click sets hazard to Severe Storm and warning shows 'UK KINGDOM ALERT · SCOTLAND' with North Sea storm surge note (Aberdeenshire/Firth of Forth). Second click on active chip deselects and warning reverts to venue profile (Munich–Milan corridor).
test_results.la_olympics_regression: PASS — venue 'la2028' + Extreme Heat hazard shows venue-warning-text: 'Projected asphalt surface expansion exceeds 42°C. Risk of heavy transit delays and venue equipment cooling strain.'
test_results.ghana_matrix_regression: PASS — 16 ghana-region-* chips render. Greater Accra + Flood → 'CATASTROPHIC RED ALERT / CRITICAL OVERFLOW — Odaw Basin & Kaneshie–Circle...'. Ashanti+Obuasi + Flood → 'ELEVATED RESIDENTIAL IMPACT — ORANGE ALERT / RESIDENTIAL WATER INTRUSION...'. Ashanti+Kumasi + Flood → 'MUNICIPAL HAZARD / High-density urban sector flash flood pooling...'. Bono (Sunyani) + Wildfire → 'DRY-SEASON HARMATTAN ALERT / Severe Harmattan vegetative drying...'. Checklist adapts per region.
test_results.accessibility_engine: PASS — 6 language buttons (lang-btn-en/twi/ga/hausa/fr/es) all present. Twi and French translations correctly change simplified-summary text. mode-btn-text/audio/visual switch panels; audio mode exposes play-voice-warning-btn that toggles to '⏹ Stop Broadcast'; visual mode renders visual-mode-panel.
test_results.broadcast_center: PASS — Empty contact + activate shows broadcast-error. With phone filled and default channels (whatsapp+sms), activation populates broadcast-feed with 2 items. Timeline slider=5 → readout 'Hours · T+8h', broadcast-mode-label='LIVE DISPATCHING / IMMEDIATE BROADCAST' (red flashing) and feed uses immediate copy ('Catastrophic flooding anomaly active. Evacuate low-lying zones immediately!'). Timeline slider=80 → readout 'Years · 2028', mode-label='PREDICTIVE BRIEFING' (blue) and feed regenerates with 'scheduled' PREDICTIVE copy.
test_results.sos_dispatch_hub: PASS — 4 buttons (sos-btn-hospitals/fire/police/military) each append confirmation entry with '✓ TRANSMISSION CONFIRMED' referencing current location (e.g. 'Bono, Ghana').
test_results.jampo_ai_hub: PASS — ai-terminal shows CONTEXT SYNC lines updating with hazard/region changes (Obuasi/Kumasi/Odaw suggestions surfaced). Submitting 'how do I evacuate' via ai-query-input appends 'OPERATOR>' line and JAMPO_AI reply.
test_results.citizen_forum: PASS — 3 seeded posts visible incl. Obuasi 'Water rising in lower Obuasi municipal houses...'. Posting via forum-post-input + forum-post-submit prepends new post; empty name defaults to 'Anonymous Citizen'.
test_results.share_center: PASS — share-btn-tiktok/facebook/whatsapp all click and change to '✓ COPIED TO CLIPBOARD' state. share-preview snippet contains 'Jampo\'s Crisis Shield AI' and 'Sampson Kwadwo Jampo' with Obuasi reference.
test_results.monetization_core: PASS — Both 'Premium Telemetry SMS Layer' and 'ISP Internet Data Revenue Matrix' cards render; 2 ad-slot-* placeholders present.
test_results.support_module: PASS — MoMo card shows '+233 598 857 686', paystack-link href='https://paystack.shop/pay/jamposcrisisshield', 8 social links present with correct hrefs (LinkedIn, Facebook Personal, Facebook Creator Page, Instagram, TikTok Personal, TikTok Platform Video, Snapchat Primary, Snapchat Secondary).
test_results.end_to_end_sync: PASS — switching hazards updates risk-level-badge color/label, map theme/markers, marquee alerts, checklist content, and accent colors propagate to Accessibility/Broadcast/AIHub/Share/Monetization modules.

critical_code_review_comments: SupportModule social links use data-testid pattern `social-link-{slug}` (e.g. social-link-linkedin-professional, social-link-snapchat-primary-promo-) rather than the `social-linkedin/social-facebook-1/...` names described in the review request. All 8 links are present with correct hrefs, so this is a naming-convention nit only — consider aligning if downstream automation expects the shorter ids.

BroadcastCenter isImmediate is only true when band === 'Hours'. Timeline value 0 (label 'Now') also produces band='Hours' via timelineReadout (v<=15), so behavior is correct, but a comment or explicit check on band ∈ {Now, Hours} would improve readability.

SupportModule uses a hard-coded slate/emerald palette that does not react to the active hazard accent (unlike the other v4 modules). Not a bug but inconsistent with the 'accent colors react to hazard theme' spec bullet.
App.js is 719 lines and holds most of the composition + US state layer + UK kingdom layer + Ghana matrix inline. Could be split for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
seed_data_creation: None (forum posts are hard-coded in AIHub.js)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend app; test via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only. US state ids are 2-letter (ca, ny, tx…) — use page.select_option with the id, not the full state name. Timeline slider needs the native React value setter trick (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set) for programmatic drag; simply setting el.value+dispatch input does not update React state. isImmediate mode requires slider ≤ 15. Social link testids follow the pattern social-link-{lowercase-hyphenated-label}.
rca of the issue: No blocker issues found in this run.
